scope: Shared /data/models, /data/datasets, pinned Kona Assets registry/locks and NetSuRF adapters. Private caches not searched. No downloads or new precision conversions.

entries.runtime: TensorFlow 2.14.1 BUILTIN_REF, one thread, no delegates; Python 3.11/NumPy 1.26.4
